content.shloka: Oṃ Gaṃ Gaṇapataye namaḥ | Vakratuṇḍa mahākāya sūryakoṭi-samaprabha | Nirvighnaṃ kuru me deva sarva-kāryeṣu sarvadā ||
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Ganapati. O Lord with the curved trunk and great body, radiant as a crore suns — make all my endeavors free of obstacles always. This avahana mantra invokes Lord Ganesh at the start of puja.
content.transliteration: Oṃ Gaṃ Gaṇapataye namaḥ Vakratuṇḍa mahākāya sūryakoṭi-samaprabha nirvighnaṃ kuru me deva sarva-kāryeṣu sarvadā

content.shloka: Gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe kaviṃ kavīnām-upamaśravastamam | Jyeṣṭharājaṃ brahmaṇāṃ brahmaṇas-pata ā naḥ śṛṇvann-ūtibhiḥ sīda sādanam ||
content.meaning: We invoke you, O Ganapati, Lord of the ganas, the sage among sages, supreme in fame. The eldest king among Brahmanas, the Lord of sacred speech — hear our prayers and be present in this seat. (Rigveda 2.23.1)
content.transliteration: Gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe kaviṃ kavīnām upamaśravastamam

content.shloka: Āvāhayāmi Gaṇeśaṃ modaka-priyam | Dhūpa-dīpa-naivedyaiś-ca pūjayāmi Vināyakam | Ehi Vighneśa pūjārthaṃ gṛhāṇa mamaṃ arghyam ||
content.meaning: I invoke Ganesha, the lover of modakas. With incense, lamp, and food offerings I worship Vinayaka. O Vighneshvara, come for worship and accept my offering of water. These are the key puja steps for Ganesh worship.
content.transliteration: Āvāhayāmi Gaṇeśaṃ modaka-priyam dhūpa-dīpa-naivedyaiś ca pūjayāmi Vināyakam

content.shloka: Sukhakartā dukhahartā vārtā Vighṇācī | Nuraṃvī puravī premu kṛpā jayācī ||
content.meaning: Creator of happiness, remover of sorrows — such is the glory of the remover of obstacles. His heart is filled with love and compassion. (Opening of the famous Ganesh Aarti)
content.transliteration: Sukhakartā dukhahartā vārtā Vighṇācī nuraṃvī puravī premu kṛpā jayācī

content.shloka: Yatra yatra Gaṇeśasya sthāpanā vidhivat kṛtā | Tatra tatra sthitiṃ yānti vighna-koṭyaḥ parāṅ-mukhāḥ ||
content.meaning: Wherever Ganesha is installed according to proper rites, there all crores of obstacles turn away and flee. This visarjan shloka concludes the Ganesh puja.
content.transliteration: Yatra yatra Gaṇeśasya sthāpanā vidhivat kṛtā tatra tatra sthitiṃ yānti vighna-koṭyaḥ parāṅmukhāḥ

content.shloka: Oṃ Namaḥ Śivāya | Namāmīśam-īśāna-nirvāṇarūpaṃ vibhuṃ vyāpakaṃ brahma-vedasvarūpam | Nijaṃ nirguṇaṃ nirvikalpaṃ nirīhaṃ cidākāśam-ākāśavāsaṃ bhaje'ham ||
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Shiva. I worship the Lord of lords, whose form is liberation, who is all-pervading, the Brahman, the essence of the Vedas. I worship Him who is self-existent, beyond attributes, beyond imagination, desireless — the consciousness-space dwelling in the expanse.
content.transliteration: Oṃ Namaḥ Śivāya Namāmīśam īśāna nirvāṇarūpaṃ vibhuṃ vyāpakaṃ brahma-vedasvarūpam

content.shloka: Āvāhayāmi deveśaṃ Śaṃbhuṃ Tripura-ghātinam | Bilvapatra-priyaṃ devaṃ pañcāmṛta-priyaṃ Haraṃ ||
content.meaning: I invoke the lord of gods, Shambhu, destroyer of Tripura. The God who loves Bilva leaves, who delights in the five nectars — I invoke Hara for this worship.
content.transliteration: Āvāhayāmi deveśaṃ Śaṃbhuṃ Tripura-ghātinam bilvapatra-priyaṃ devaṃ pañcāmṛta-priyaṃ Haraṃ

content.shloka: Abhiṣekāmi deveśaṃ pañcāmṛtena śūlinam | Gaṅgā-toyena śuddhena bilvapātraiś-ca pūjayet ||
content.meaning: I anoint the Lord of gods, the trident-bearer, with the five nectars (panchamrita). One should worship with sacred Ganga water and Bilva leaves. These are the key ablution rites for Shiva.
content.transliteration: Abhiṣekāmi deveśaṃ pañcāmṛtena śūlinam Gaṅgā-toyena śuddhena bilvapātraiś ca pūjayet

content.shloka: Karpur-Gaurāṃ Karuṇāvatāram Saṃsāra-sāram Bhujagendra-hāram | Sadā-vasantaṃ hṛdayāravinde bhavaṃ bhavānī-sahitaṃ namāmi ||
content.meaning: I bow to the one who is white as camphor, the incarnation of compassion, the essence of worldly existence, who wears the king of serpents as a garland. I bow to Bhava who always dwells in the lotus of the heart, together with Bhavani.
content.transliteration: Karpur-Gaurāṃ Karuṇāvatāram Saṃsāra-sāram Bhujagendra-hāram

content.shloka: Yatra yatra Mahādevo yatra yatra Vṛṣa-dhvajaḥ | Tatra tatra sthitā Lakṣmīḥ sthiratvāṃ ca punar-vasuḥ ||
content.meaning: Wherever Mahadeva is, wherever the bull-bannered one resides, there Lakshmi dwells in stability and ever-renewed prosperity. This concludes the Shiva puja visarjan.
content.transliteration: Yatra yatra Mahādevo yatra yatra Vṛṣa-dhvajaḥ tatra tatra sthitā Lakṣmīḥ sthiratvāṃ ca punar vasuḥ

content.shloka: Oṃ Namo Nārāyaṇāya | Śāntākāraṃ bhujagaśayanaṃ padmanābhaṃ sureśam | Viśvādhāraṃ gaganasadṛśaṃ meghavarṇaṃ śubhāṅgam ||
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Narayana. He of peaceful form, reclining on the serpent, lotus-naveled, lord of gods, support of the universe, vast as the sky, dark as clouds, with auspicious limbs.
content.transliteration: Oṃ Namo Nārāyaṇāya Śāntākāraṃ bhujagaśayanaṃ padmanābhaṃ sureśam

content.shloka: Āvāhayāmi deveśaṃ Viṣṇuṃ sarva-jagat-patim | Tulasī-dala-saṃyuktaṃ pūjayāmi Janārdanam ||
content.meaning: I invoke the lord of gods, Vishnu, lord of all worlds. I worship Janardana with Tulasi leaves — the most sacred offering to Lord Vishnu.
content.transliteration: Āvāhayāmi deveśaṃ Viṣṇuṃ sarva-jagat-patim tulasī-dala-saṃyuktaṃ pūjayāmi Janārdanam

content.shloka: Pītāmbara-dharaṃ devaṃ śaṅkha-cakra-gadā-dharam | Dhūpa-dīpa-naivedyena pūjayāmi caturbhujam ||
content.meaning: The god wearing yellow garments, bearing conch, discus, and mace — I worship the four-armed Lord with incense, lamp, and food offerings.
content.transliteration: Pītāmbara-dharaṃ devaṃ śaṅkha-cakra-gadā-dharam dhūpa-dīpa-naivedyena pūjayāmi caturbhujam

content.shloka: Maṅgalaṃ Bhagavān Viṣṇuḥ maṅgalaṃ Garuḍa-dhvajaḥ | Maṅgalaṃ Puṇḍarīkākṣo maṅgalāyatano Hariḥ ||
content.meaning: Auspiciousness is Bhagavan Vishnu, auspiciousness is the Garuda-bannered one. Auspiciousness is the lotus-eyed one, the abode of all auspiciousness is Hari.
content.transliteration: Maṅgalaṃ Bhagavān Viṣṇuḥ maṅgalaṃ Garuḍa-dhvajaḥ maṅgalaṃ Puṇḍarīkākṣo maṅgalāyatano Hariḥ

content.shloka: Gacchoddhavasva Bhagavan sarvatra-gatiḥ sadā | Kṣīrodadhi-nivāsāya punar-āgamanāya ca ||
content.meaning: O Lord, please depart, you who move everywhere always. Go to your abode in the ocean of milk, and return again. This is the Vishnu visarjan prayer.
content.transliteration: Gacchoddhavasva Bhagavan sarvatra-gatiḥ sadā kṣīrodadhi-nivāsāya punar āgamanāya ca

content.shloka: Oṃ Hrīṃ Durgāyai namaḥ | Jaya Tvaṃ Devī Cāmuṇḍe Jaya Bhūtāpahāriṇi | Jaya Sarvagate Devī Kālarātri namo'stu te ||
content.meaning: Om Hreem, salutations to Durga. Victory to you, O Chamunda, victory to the destroyer of evil beings. Victory to the all-pervading Goddess, Kalaratri — salutations to you.
content.transliteration: Oṃ Hrīṃ Durgāyai namaḥ Jaya Tvaṃ Devī Cāmuṇḍe Jaya Bhūtāpahāriṇi

content.shloka: Āvāhayāmi Durgāṃ ca siṃha-vāhinīṃ parām | Aṣṭādaśa-bhujāṃ Devīṃ mahiṣāsura-mardanīm ||
content.meaning: I invoke the supreme Durga, the lion-rider, the eighteen-armed Goddess, the crusher of the buffalo demon Mahishasura.
content.transliteration: Āvāhayāmi Durgāṃ ca siṃha-vāhinīṃ parām aṣṭādaśa-bhujāṃ Devīṃ mahiṣāsura-mardanīm

content.shloka: Kumkuma-candana-puṣpaiś-ca dhūpa-dīpa-naivedyakaiḥ | Pūjayāmi Jagaddhātrīṃ Durgāṃ durita-nāśinīm ||
content.meaning: With kumkum, sandalwood, flowers, incense, lamp, and food offerings — I worship Durga, the sustainer of the world, the destroyer of all sins.
content.transliteration: Kumkuma-candana-puṣpaiś ca dhūpa-dīpa-naivedyakaiḥ pūjayāmi Jagaddhātrīṃ Durgāṃ durita-nāśinīm

content.shloka: Sarvā-maṅgala-māṅgalye Śive sarvārtha-sādhike | Śaraṇye Tryambake Gauri Nārāyaṇi namo'stu te ||
content.meaning: O auspicious among all that is auspicious, O Shiva who fulfills all goals, O refuge, three-eyed Gauri — O Narayani, salutations to you.
content.transliteration: Sarvā-maṅgala-māṅgalye Śive sarvārtha-sādhike śaraṇye Tryambake Gauri Nārāyaṇi namo'stu te

content.shloka: Gaccha devi yathā-sthānaṃ punar-āgamanāya ca | Yāvad-āhvāna-samayaṃ tāvat-tvaṃ sannidhau bhava ||
content.meaning: O Goddess, return to your abode and come again. Until the next invocation, remain graciously present near us. This is the Durga visarjan mantra.
content.transliteration: Gaccha devi yathā-sthānaṃ punar āgamanāya ca yāvad āhvāna-samayaṃ tāvat tvaṃ sannidhau bhava

content.shloka: Oṃ Śrīṃ Mahālakṣmyai namaḥ | Namastestu Mahāmāye Śrīpīṭhe sura-pūjite | Śaṅkha-cakra-gadā-haste Mahālakṣmi namo'stu te ||
content.meaning: Om Shreem, salutations to Mahalakshmi. Salutations to the great Goddess of illusion, seated on the sacred seat, worshipped by the gods, holding conch, discus, and mace — O Mahalakshmi, salutations.
content.transliteration: Oṃ Śrīṃ Mahālakṣmyai namaḥ Namastestu Mahāmāye Śrīpīṭhe sura-pūjite

content.shloka: Āvāhayāmi Lakṣmīṃ ca padma-vāsinīṃ śubhām | Hema-varṇāṃ catur-bhujāṃ sarvābharaṇa-bhūṣitām ||
content.meaning: I invoke the auspicious Lakshmi who dwells in the lotus, golden-complexioned, four-armed, adorned with all ornaments.
content.transliteration: Āvāhayāmi Lakṣmīṃ ca padma-vāsinīṃ śubhām hema-varṇāṃ catur-bhujāṃ sarvābharaṇa-bhūṣitām

content.shloka: Padmāsane padmakare sarvalokaika-pūjite | Nārāyaṇa-priye Devī dhūpa-dīpādi-pūjitā ||
content.meaning: O one seated on lotus, lotus-handed, worshipped by all the worlds, O beloved of Narayana — I worship you with incense, lamp, and other offerings.
content.transliteration: Padmāsane padmakare sarvalokaika-pūjite Nārāyaṇa-priye Devī dhūpa-dīpādi-pūjitā

content.shloka: Lakṣmīṃ kṣīra-samudra-rāja-tanayāṃ Śrīraṅga-dhāmeśvarīm | Dāsī-bhūta-samasta-deva-vanitāṃ lokaika-dīpāṅkurām ||
content.meaning: Lakshmi, daughter of the ocean of milk, queen of Shrirangam. She before whom all celestial women stand as servants, the sole lamp illuminating the world.
content.transliteration: Lakṣmīṃ kṣīra-samudra-rāja-tanayāṃ Śrīraṅga-dhāmeśvarīm

content.shloka: Gaccha Lakṣmi yathā-sthānaṃ sthirā bhava gṛhe mama | Tvatprasādān-mahābhāge dhana-dhānya-samanvitam ||
content.meaning: O Lakshmi, return to your abode, but remain steady in my home. By your grace, O fortunate one, may it be endowed with wealth and grain. This is the Lakshmi visarjan prayer.
content.transliteration: Gaccha Lakṣmi yathā-sthānaṃ sthirā bhava gṛhe mama tvatprasādān mahābhāge dhana-dhānya-samanvitam

content.shloka: Oṃ Aiṃ Sarasvatyai namaḥ | Yā Kuṃdendu-tuṣāra-hāra-dhavalā yā śubhra-vastrāvṛtā | Yā vīṇā-vara-daṇḍa-maṇḍita-karā yā śveta-padmāsanā ||
content.meaning: Om Aim, salutations to Saraswati. She who is white as jasmine, moon, and snow, draped in white garments, whose hands are adorned with the excellent veena, who is seated on a white lotus.
content.transliteration: Oṃ Aiṃ Sarasvatyai namaḥ Yā Kuṃdendu-tuṣāra-hāra-dhavalā yā śubhra-vastrāvṛtā

content.shloka: Āvāhayāmi Vāgdevīṃ puṣpa-mālā-vibhūṣitām | Pustaka-akṣa-mālā-yuktāṃ Vīṇā-puṣṭaka-dhāriṇīm ||
content.meaning: I invoke the Goddess of speech, adorned with flower garlands, holding a book and rosary, bearer of the veena and scriptures.
content.transliteration: Āvāhayāmi Vāgdevīṃ puṣpa-mālā-vibhūṣitām pustaka-akṣa-mālā-yuktāṃ Vīṇā-puṣṭaka-dhāriṇīm

content.shloka: Vidyā-dātrī tapas-siddhe dhūpa-dīpa-naivedyakaiḥ | Pūjayāmi Jagadvandyāṃ Sarasvatīṃ manohariṇīm ||
content.meaning: O bestower of knowledge, perfected through penance — with incense, lamp, and food offerings I worship the world-revered, enchanting Saraswati.
content.transliteration: Vidyā-dātrī tapas-siddhe dhūpa-dīpa-naivedyakaiḥ pūjayāmi Jagadvandyāṃ Sarasvatīṃ manohariṇīm

content.shloka: Sarasvatī namastu-bhyaṃ varade kāmarūpiṇi | Vidyārambhaṃ kariṣyāmi siddhir-bhavatu me sadā ||
content.meaning: O Saraswati, salutations to you, O boon-giver who takes desired forms. I am commencing my studies — may I always attain success.
content.transliteration: Sarasvatī namastubhyaṃ varade kāmarūpiṇi vidyārambhaṃ kariṣyāmi siddhir bhavatu me sadā

content.shloka: Gaccha Devi yathā-sthānaṃ punar-āgamanāya ca | Mama vidyā-phalaṃ dehi sthirā bhava hṛdi priye ||
content.meaning: O Goddess, return to your abode and come again. Grant me the fruit of knowledge and remain steady in my heart, O beloved one.
content.transliteration: Gaccha Devi yathā-sthānaṃ punar āgamanāya ca mama vidyā-phalaṃ dehi sthirā bhava hṛdi priye

content.shloka: Oṃ Hanumate namaḥ | Manojavaṃ māruta-tulya-vegaṃ jitendriyaṃ buddhi-matāṃ variṣṭham | Vātātmajaṃ vānara-yūtha-mukhyaṃ Śrīrāma-dūtaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye ||
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Hanuman. I take refuge in the messenger of Shri Rama — swift as thought, fast as the wind, master of the senses, chief among the wise, son of the wind god, leader of the monkey host.
content.transliteration: Oṃ Hanumate namaḥ Manojavaṃ māruta-tulya-vegaṃ jitendriyaṃ buddhi-matāṃ variṣṭham

content.shloka: Āvāhayāmi Hanumat-pavana-tanayam | Sindūra-lepitaṃ devaṃ vajra-deham mahābalam ||
content.meaning: I invoke Hanuman, son of the wind god, the deity anointed with vermilion, whose body is strong as a thunderbolt, of immense strength.
content.transliteration: Āvāhayāmi Hanumat pavana-tanayam sindūra-lepitaṃ devaṃ vajra-deham mahābalam

content.shloka: Sindūra-tilaka-saṃyuktaṃ vāyu-putraṃ mahābalam | Dhūpa-dīpa-naivedyena pūjayāmi Kapīśvaram ||
content.meaning: With sindoor tilak, the mighty son of Vayu — I worship the lord of monkeys with incense, lamp, and food offerings.
content.transliteration: Sindūra-tilaka-saṃyuktaṃ vāyu-putraṃ mahābalam dhūpa-dīpa-naivedyena pūjayāmi Kapīśvaram

content.shloka: Buddhir-balaṃ yaśo dhairyaṃ nirbhayatvam-arogitā | Ajāḍyaṃ vāk-paṭutvañ-ca Hanūmat-smaraṇāt bhavet ||
content.meaning: Intelligence, strength, fame, courage, fearlessness, good health, freedom from lethargy, and eloquence of speech — all come from remembering Hanuman.
content.transliteration: Buddhir-balaṃ yaśo dhairyaṃ nirbhayatvam arogitā ajāḍyaṃ vāk-paṭutvañ ca Hanūmat smaraṇāt bhavet

content.shloka: Rāmāya Rāmabhadrāya Rāmacandrāya vedhase | Raghunāthāya nāthāya Sītāyāḥ pataye namaḥ ||
content.meaning: Salutations to Rama, to Ramabhadra, to Ramachandra, to the creator, to Raghunatha, to the Lord, to the consort of Sita. This Ram Dhun is chanted to conclude Hanuman puja.
content.transliteration: Rāmāya Rāmabhadrāya Rāmacandrāya vedhase Raghunāthāya nāthāya Sītāyāḥ pataye namaḥ

content.shloka: Oṃ Sūryāya namaḥ | Japā-kusuma-saṃkāśaṃ kāśyapeyaṃ mahādyutim | Tamoghnaṃ sarva-pāpaghnaṃ praṇato'smi Divākaram ||
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Surya. I prostrate before the Sun God who shines like the hibiscus flower, son of Kashyapa, of great brilliance, destroyer of darkness and all sins.
content.transliteration: Oṃ Sūryāya namaḥ Japā-kusuma-saṃkāśaṃ kāśyapeyaṃ mahādyutim tamoghnaṃ sarva-pāpaghnaṃ praṇato'smi Divākaram

content.shloka: Āvāhayāmi Sūryaṃ ca sapta-aśva-ratha-saṃsthitam | Āditya-hṛdayaṃ puṇyaṃ arghyaṃ gṛhāṇa Bhāskara ||
content.meaning: I invoke Surya, seated on a chariot of seven horses. O Bhaskara, accept this sacred water offering — the holy Aditya Hridayam.
content.transliteration: Āvāhayāmi Sūryaṃ ca sapta-aśva-ratha-saṃsthitam Āditya-hṛdayaṃ puṇyaṃ arghyaṃ gṛhāṇa Bhāskara

content.shloka: Oṃ Mitrāya namaḥ | Oṃ Ravaye namaḥ | Oṃ Sūryāya namaḥ | Oṃ Bhānave namaḥ | Oṃ Khagāya namaḥ | Oṃ Pūṣṇe namaḥ ||
content.meaning: Salutations to the Friend, to the Shining One, to the Sun, to the Radiant One, to the Sky-mover, to the Nourisher. These are the first six of the twelve Surya Namaskar mantras.
content.transliteration: Oṃ Mitrāya namaḥ Oṃ Ravaye namaḥ Oṃ Sūryāya namaḥ Oṃ Bhānave namaḥ

content.shloka: Ādityasya namaḥkāraṃ ye kurvanti dine dine | Āyuḥ prajñā balaṃ vīryaṃ tejas-teṣāṃ ca jāyate ||
content.meaning: Those who offer salutations to the Sun God daily — longevity, wisdom, strength, valor, and radiance are born in them.
content.transliteration: Ādityasya namaḥkāraṃ ye kurvanti dine dine āyuḥ prajñā balaṃ vīryaṃ tejas teṣāṃ ca jāyate

content.shloka: Gaccha Sūrya yathā-sthānaṃ prabhayā pūritaṃ jagat | Punaragamanāya ca ārogyaṃ dehi Bhāskara ||
content.meaning: O Surya, return to your abode, the world filled with your radiance. Come again, and O Bhaskara, grant me health.
content.transliteration: Gaccha Sūrya yathā-sthānaṃ prabhayā pūritaṃ jagat punaragamanāya ca ārogyaṃ dehi Bhāskara

content.shloka: Oṃ Tulasyai namaḥ | Yānmūle sarvatīrthāni yanmadhye sarvadevataḥ | Yadagre sarvavedāśca Tulasīṃ tvaṃ namāmyaham ||
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Tulasi. At whose roots are all pilgrimage sites, in whose middle dwell all deities, at whose tips reside all the Vedas — O Tulasi, I bow to you.
content.transliteration: Oṃ Tulasyai namaḥ Yānmūle sarvatīrthāni yanmadhye sarvadevataḥ yadagre sarvavedāśca Tulasīṃ tvaṃ namāmyaham

content.shloka: Āvāhayāmi Tulasīṃ Viṣṇu-priyāṃ śubhām | Jala-gandha-akṣata-puṣpaiḥ pūjayāmi Haripriyām ||
content.meaning: I invoke the auspicious Tulasi, beloved of Vishnu. With water, sandalwood, rice, and flowers I worship the beloved of Hari.
content.transliteration: Āvāhayāmi Tulasīṃ Viṣṇu-priyāṃ śubhām jala-gandha-akṣata-puṣpaiḥ pūjayāmi Haripriyām

content.shloka: Mahā-prasāda-janani sarva-saubhāgya-vardhini | Ādhi-vyādhi-harā nityaṃ Tulasī tvaṃ namo'stu te ||
content.meaning: O birthgiver of great divine grace, enhancer of all good fortune, eternal remover of mental and physical afflictions — O Tulasi, salutations to you.
content.transliteration: Mahā-prasāda-janani sarva-saubhāgya-vardhini ādhi-vyādhi-harā nityaṃ Tulasī tvaṃ namo'stu te

content.shloka: Dhanyā Tulasī gopikaṃ yeṣāṃ gṛhe gṛhe | Tangṛhaṃ tīrtha-bhūtaṃ hi na yānti yama-kinkarāḥ ||
content.meaning: Blessed are those homes where Tulasi is present. Such a home becomes a holy pilgrimage site and the messengers of Yama never visit it.
content.transliteration: Dhanyā Tulasī gopikaṃ yeṣāṃ gṛhe gṛhe tangṛhaṃ tīrtha-bhūtaṃ hi na yānti yama-kinkarāḥ

content.shloka: Tulasī amṛta-janmāsi sadā tvaṃ keśava-priye | Keśavārthaṃ cinomi tvāṃ varadā bhava śobhane ||
content.meaning: O Tulasi, you are born of nectar, you are ever dear to Keshava. I pluck you for the sake of Keshava — be boon-granting, O beautiful one. (Plucking prayer)
content.transliteration: Tulasī amṛta-janmāsi sadā tvaṃ keśava-priye keśavārthaṃ cinomi tvāṃ varadā bhava śobhane

content.shloka: Oṃ Navagraha-devatābhyo namaḥ | Ādityāya Somāya Maṅgalāya Budhāya ca | Guru-Śukra-Śanibhyaśca Rāhave Ketave namaḥ ||
content.meaning: Om, salutations to the nine planetary deities. Salutations to the Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, and Ketu.
content.transliteration: Oṃ Navagraha-devatābhyo namaḥ Ādityāya Somāya Maṅgalāya Budhāya ca Guru-Śukra-Śanibhyaśca Rāhave Ketave namaḥ

content.shloka: Japā-kusuma-saṅkāśaṃ kāśyapeyaṃ mahādyutim | Tamoghnaṃ sarva-pāpaghnaṃ praṇato'smi Divākaram ||
content.meaning: I prostrate to the Sun, like a hibiscus flower, son of Kashyapa, of great radiance, destroyer of darkness and all sins. (Surya — the first graha)
content.transliteration: Japā-kusuma-saṅkāśaṃ kāśyapeyaṃ mahādyutim tamoghnaṃ sarva-pāpaghnaṃ praṇato'smi Divākaram

content.shloka: Dadhi-śaṅkha-tuṣārābhaṃ kṣīrodārṇava-sambhavam | Namāmi Śaśinaṃ Somaṃ Śambhor-mukuṭa-bhūṣaṇam ||
content.meaning: I bow to the Moon (Soma), who shines like curd, conch, and snow, born from the ocean of milk, the ornament on Shambhu's crown. (Chandra — the second graha)
content.transliteration: Dadhi-śaṅkha-tuṣārābhaṃ kṣīrodārṇava-sambhavam namāmi Śaśinaṃ Somaṃ Śambhor mukuṭa-bhūṣaṇam

content.shloka: Dharaṇī-garbha-saṃbhūtaṃ vidyut-kānti-samaprabham | Kumāraṃ Śakti-hastaṃ ca Maṅgalaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||
content.meaning: I prostrate to Mars (Mangala), born from the womb of the Earth, radiant as lightning, youthful, wielding a spear in hand. (Mangala — the third graha)
content.transliteration: Dharaṇī-garbha-saṃbhūtaṃ vidyut-kānti-samaprabham kumāraṃ Śakti-hastaṃ ca Maṅgalaṃ praṇamāmyaham

content.shloka: Nīlāñjana-samābhāsaṃ ravi-putraṃ yamāgrajam | Chāyā-mārtaṇḍa-sambhūtaṃ taṃ namāmi Śanaiścaram ||
content.meaning: I bow to Saturn (Shani), who shines like blue collyrium, son of the Sun, elder brother of Yama, born of Chhaya and Martanda. (Shani — completes the nine planets)
content.transliteration: Nīlāñjana-samābhāsaṃ ravi-putraṃ yamāgrajam chāyā-mārtaṇḍa-sambhūtaṃ taṃ namāmi Śanaiścaram

content.shloka: Oṃ Namo Bhagavate Vāsudevāya | Satyaṃ Nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ sarva-kāmaphalapradam | Pūjayāmi sadā bhaktyā praṇamāmi muhur-muhuḥ ||
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Vasudeva. I worship Lord Satyanarayan, the bestower of all desired fruits, always with devotion. I bow to him again and again.
content.transliteration: Oṃ Namo Bhagavate Vāsudevāya Satyaṃ Nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ sarva-kāmaphalapradam

content.shloka: Āvāhayāmi Satyeśaṃ pīṭāmbara-dharaṃ Harim | Pañcāmṛta-snāna-pūrvaṃ gandha-puṣpādi-pūjitam ||
content.meaning: I invoke the Lord of Truth, Hari who wears yellow garments. First bathed in panchamrita, then worshipped with sandalwood, flowers, and other offerings.
content.transliteration: Āvāhayāmi Satyeśaṃ pīṭāmbara-dharaṃ Harim pañcāmṛta-snāna-pūrvaṃ gandha-puṣpādi-pūjitam

content.shloka: Śrī Satyanārāyaṇa-devasya prasanno varado bhava | Kathā-śravaṇa-mātrena sarva-pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
content.meaning: May Lord Shri Satyanarayan be pleased and bestow boons. By merely hearing His story (katha), may all sins be destroyed.
content.transliteration: Śrī Satyanārāyaṇa-devasya prasanno varado bhava kathā-śravaṇa-mātrena sarva-pāpaṃ vyapohatu

content.shloka: Naivedyaṃ pañca-bhakṣyaṃ ca guḍa-kṣīra-ghṛta-anvitam | Śarkarā-saha-sapāmaṃ ca naivedyaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||
content.meaning: Please accept the naivedya of five foods with jaggery, milk, and ghee, accompanied by sugar and sheera (sweet). The prasad of Satyanarayan puja is sacred and must be distributed to all.
content.transliteration: Naivedyaṃ pañca-bhakṣyaṃ ca guḍa-kṣīra-ghṛta-anvitam śarkarā-saha-sapāmaṃ ca naivedyaṃ pratigṛhyatām

content.shloka: Gaccha deva yathā-sthānaṃ punar-āgamanāya ca | Satya-bhakti-pradāyārthe śreyaḥ kuru Janārdana ||
content.meaning: O Lord, return to your abode and come again. For the sake of bestowing true devotion, grant us the highest good, O Janardana.
content.transliteration: Gaccha deva yathā-sthānaṃ punar āgamanāya ca satya-bhakti-pradāyārthe śreyaḥ kuru Janārdana

content.shloka: Oṃ Vāstu-puruṣāya namaḥ | Vāstu-devaṃ namasyāmi bhūṣaṇaṃ bhuvana-trayam | Vāstudevaṃ ca praṇamya sarva-vighna-vināśanam ||
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Vastu Purusha. I bow to the Vastu deity, the ornament of the three worlds. Having bowed to the Vastu god, may all obstacles be destroyed.
content.transliteration: Oṃ Vāstu-puruṣāya namaḥ Vāstu-devaṃ namasyāmi bhūṣaṇaṃ bhuvana-trayam

content.shloka: Āvāhayāmi Vāstu-devaṃ sarva-doṣa-nivārakam | Bhūmi-devaṃ namaskṛtya gṛha-praveśa-kāraṇam ||
content.meaning: I invoke the Vastu deity, remover of all defects. Having saluted the Earth deity, this is performed for the purpose of house entering (Griha Pravesh).
content.transliteration: Āvāhayāmi Vāstu-devaṃ sarva-doṣa-nivārakam bhūmi-devaṃ namaskṛtya gṛha-praveśa-kāraṇam

content.shloka: Iśāne Śiva-devaṃ ca āgneye Agni-devatā | Nairṛtye Rakṣo-devaṃ ca vāyavye Pavana-devatā ||
content.meaning: In the northeast (Ishanya) is Shiva, in the southeast (Agneya) is the Fire deity, in the southwest (Nairritya) is the deity of protection, and in the northwest (Vayavya) is the Wind deity. (Vastu directional deities)
content.transliteration: Iśāne Śiva-devaṃ ca āgneye Agni-devatā nairṛtye Rakṣo-devaṃ ca vāyavye Pavana-devatā

content.shloka: Vāstu-śāntiṃ kuru deveśa gṛhe'smin sukha-vardhanam | Saubhāgya-lakṣmī-sahitaṃ āyur-ārogya-sādhakam ||
content.meaning: O Lord of gods, perform Vastu Shanti in this house to increase happiness. May it be endowed with good fortune and Lakshmi, and may it promote longevity and health.
content.transliteration: Vāstu-śāntiṃ kuru deveśa gṛhe'smin sukha-vardhanam saubhāgya-lakṣmī-sahitaṃ āyur-ārogya-sādhakam

content.shloka: Gaccha Vāstu-deva sthānaṃ punar-āgamanaṃ kuru | Gṛhe'smin sarva-doṣāṇāṃ śāntiṃ kuru sadā prabho ||
content.meaning: O Vastu deity, return to your abode and come again. In this house, always bring peace from all defects, O Lord.
content.transliteration: Gaccha Vāstu-deva sthānaṃ punar āgamanaṃ kuru gṛhe'smin sarva-doṣāṇāṃ śāntiṃ kuru sadā prabho
